description: Extend the existing UI-backed permission operation rather than duplicating it. Add an incremental direct-grant mutation contract through Ingestion, Channels/DataSourceBridge, DiskBridge and Storage/Permissions. Preserve manage authorization, actor and explicit bypass context, inheritance, affected descendant IDs and indexed-document synchronization. Contract: add/update direct person/team/public grants and revoke named direct principals; reject overlaps/invalid rights; unrelated and inherited grants remain unchanged. Verification: authorization failures, preservation, folders/descendants, rollback/concurrency and sync failure reporting.
title: [zaq-mc1.1] Extend shared incremental data-source ACL mutation
